change.summary: Replace Inventory Tabs 0.10.1 with a source-disclosed patch that discovers tabs only from loaded client state

modifiers.before: Construct every registered entity type in a synthetic FakeLevel during client login
modifiers.after: Classify only actual nearby entities already present in the client level

modifiers.before: Read every nearby block position during tab discovery and stale-tab handling without an explicit loaded-chunk guard
modifiers.after: Require Level.hasChunkAt before block matching, line-of-sight, hover text, stale-tab handling or tab opening

rationale.purpose: Prevent Inventory Tabs from requesting unavailable chunks or aborting Forge login while retaining tabs for loaded nearby blocks and inventory entities
rationale.decision_source: Direct user request on 2026-11-13 after the Inventory Tabs and Brewery login conflict was isolated
rationale.user_requested: Make Inventory Tabs work only inside loaded chunks, remove the original artifact and install a patched version
rationale.implementation_choices: Pin MIT upstream commit ed11c477a1cb6e6b184d73df1e8784ee22268a04, remove FakeLevel from the compiled artifact, classify actual loaded entities and guard every block-tab read with hasChunkAt

introduced.summary: Install Inventory Tabs 0.10.1-jem.1 and remove the upstream runtime artifact

history.summary: Removed login-time synthetic entity construction and restricted block-tab reads to loaded chunks

relations: loaded nearby entity -> native inventory capability -> Inventory Tabs entity tab
loaded nearby block -> native block state -> Inventory Tabs block tab
unloaded block position -> hasChunkAt false -> no block read and no tab
notes: Inventory Tabs remains client-only and keeps its native mod ID and configuration
Villager, tamed-horse, chest-boat and generic inventory entity tab types are preserved
The patched production artifact SHA-256 is 7912952426d4c1733295742f6266deafb463dcd0f3a5985527f8a2e9cc2bf021
MineRENT, stable JustEnoughMods and the immutable release baseline remain unchanged
unresolved: Player acceptance remains pending until Test JustEnoughMods reconnects with the patched artifact
